meaning: Relative-frame conditional on one rigid selected individual n, a world-indexed existence-degree assignment and one shared Preorder of degrees. Actual reflexivity and n's explicit NecessaryAt premise supply actual presence and a nonempty root-accessible family; no hidden inhabitedness, S5, transitivity or causal-soundness premise is used. For any existing y at a root-accessible evaluation world u, explicit excluded middle separates y=n from the other-directed case. The former gives degree reflexivity; the latter uses the pointwise potential-cause commitment and the weak bound on existing relata at u to give intensity(u,y)≤intensity(u,n), regardless of which successor witnesses possible causation. Conditional invariance is applied to the separately supplied necessity premise and transfers the bound from n at u through its standpoint degree to n at any other root-accessible world v. Thus n is globally maximum among existing accessible-world degree pairs at every accessible world, with ties allowed. No possible-maximum premise is used: the existence-degree shortcut therefore bypasses source step5 within this analyst specialization. This does not dispense with step4 for value, derive actual causation, causal sufficiency, a unique necessary individual, God, or unqualified scope over all metaphysical worlds. The selected singular, pointwise, other-directed commitment is not attributed as the whole of source6, which also allows plurality and has unresolved literal-all versus other-directed and joint versus varying-witness scope. All philosophical premises remain open; root-premise delta is none.
